summary: Delegator (cdecl): invokes the collision init routine sub_44C600 and converts its boolean result into an integer via BooleanToIntConversion, returning that integer. Used to start collision-system initialization.

operations.description: Invoke the collision initialization routine referenced by global sub_44C600.
Convert the boolean result of sub_44C600 into an integer via BooleanToIntConversion.
Return the integer result of the boolean-to-int conversion.

unresolved: Whether sub_44C600 is a direct function address or an indirect call target is unresolved; it is recorded as a global reference.
The calling context that triggers collision initialization is not visible from this function alone.
